summary: CivicState is a built-but-unvalidated paid civic-letter workflow; continue only through measured beta.
authority: POM soul-review + wrk.dog merge constitute adoption — operator ruling 2026-06-12; see the PR's POM record

honestyLabels.evidence: A claim traceable to repo, dispatch, registry, or inspected code files.
honestyLabels.assumption: A claim modeled from repo context or general reasoning without external research in workspace-only mode.

thesis.current: CivicState may become a transactional civic-advocacy product if the paid letter loop validates, but it is not yet investible.
thesis.label: [evidence: BUSINESS.md; registry note in dispatch]
thesis.operatorSensitivity: Registry notes call this a personal/research asset and ask whether it should pitch as a business.

methods.name: Workspace-only modeling
sources: No network research used; external market claims are marked as assumptions.

customerDefinition.primary: US resident with a specific civic issue who needs official lookup, citation-backed drafting, and delivery help.
excluded: Legal claimants seeking filings or demand letters
customerDefinition.label: [evidence: BUSINESS.md; MASTER_PLAN.md]

holes.hole: No evidence of real paid conversion.
holes.mitigation: Run beta funnel and record preview, pay-click, paid, delivered, bounced, and reply events.
holes.residualRisk: Civic frustration may not convert into low-ticket purchases.

holes.mitigation: Seed delivery tests, monitor bounce/spam, and pause domains above threshold.
holes.residualRisk: Official inboxes may block or ignore AI-assisted letters.

holes.mitigation: Run provider evaluation and compare ZIP results against manual lookup.
holes.residualRisk: Poor local coverage weakens the core promise.

holes.mitigation: Get qualified review of disclaimers, AI disclosure, CAN-SPAM, lobbying boundary, and moderation rules.
holes.residualRisk: Compliance overhead may exceed transaction economics.

risks.antiPlan: Do not expand into community, SEO archive, API, fax, certified mail, or autonomous follow-up until a paid email-only campaign validates end-to-end.

assumptionLedger: Users will pay $5-$25 for constituent letters [evidence: implemented tiers; demand unvalidated].
Preview-to-pay conversion can reach 3% [assumption: planning target].
Government-domain deliverability can reach 85% [assumption: planning target].
Local official coverage can reach 60% [assumption: planning target].
One operator can keep review under 30 minutes/day [evidence: planning constraint; unvalidated].

roadmap.shape: Single-worker-sized validation tasks mapped to BUSINESS.md headings.

adoption.requires: Operator merge and later market evidence before investible status.

freshness.stalePlanResolved: Older March and April planning artifacts are preserved but superseded by BUSINESS.md on 2026-06-20 [evidence: assistant runtime].
